newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australia 10-yr bond seeking higher ground.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australia 10-yr bond seeking higher ground.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract ended SYCOM firm and will be looking to test higher levels after holding support at 92.720 on Wednesday.
*May labour force due 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT). Employment seen up 15,000, unemploment unchanged at 8.7 percent.
The June Australian 10-year bond futures contract ended SYCOM firm and will be looking to test higher levels after holding support at 92.720 on Wednesday.

The contract ended the after hours session at 92.795 compared with Wednesday's 92.770 pit close and stands just short of the six month high of 92.830 set in SYCOM last Friday and after the U.S. non-farm payrolls report.

Peter Pontikis, technical strategist at Westpac, believes as the contract has survived a test of 92.700/92.720 and its pre-payroll starting price, it can now resume its upward momentum to a projected 92.880 and higher.
However, "should 92.750 support give, a serious reversal in the previous trend is triggered," Pontikis added.
The local market sees its own labour force report for May at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT), which could encourage further talk of another monetary policy easing if it proves weak.
Median forecasts centre on a moderate employment rise of 15,000, while the unemployment rate is seen sticking at 8.7 percent, according to a Reuters survey of economists.
U.S. Treasuries were little changed on Wednesday ahead of U.S. retail sales for May later on Thursday.
